answer: Divergent History Challenge. Each identity must sign a hash-chained log of its actions; peers gossip these logs through a shared sable feed. Duplicate copies of one agent diverge at the fork, and any peer can submit both branches to slash the identity. The attacker must maintain distinct, costly histories per clone, like separate paths across a dune, while each new inlet node re-verifies the full chain. Cloning costs one full history plus ongoing compute per copy.
